title: How complex is the menu?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the dimensions compared rather than option count alone.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the dimensions compared rather than option count alone affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Checks, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the dimensions compared rather than option count alone in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
